tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the authenticated athlete's biometric profile (bodyweight, height, sex, primary modality, training phase, weekly time budget) and upcoming race goals. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: get_sessions
tools.description: List the athlete's completed and planned training sessions over the last `days` days (1–90, default 14) or on a specific `date` (YYYY-MM-DD). Call before prescribing today's workout.

tools.name: get_muscle_volume
tools.description: Audit this week's effective hard sets across 17 muscle groups (1.0x prime mover, 0.5x synergist, RPE >= 6 gating) against evidence-based MEV / MAV / MRV weekly volume landmarks.

tools.name: log_workout
tools.description: Record one COMPLETED exercise into the athlete's STRUGGL ledger (with duplicate-write protection, automatic PR tracking, and 17-muscle weekly volume accounting). Call once per exercise.

tools.name: plan_workout
tools.description: Schedule one PLANNED exercise on the athlete's STRUGGL training calendar for `date` (YYYY-MM-DD). Only schedule when the athlete asks for it; call once per exercise.

tools.name: hyrox_pace
tools.description: Public calculator (NO token needed): compute Hyrox 8x1 km compromised run splits, target pace band, estimated total race time, and Riegel 10k/Half/Marathon predictions from a 5 km time.

tools.name: strength_benchmark
tools.description: Public calculator (NO token needed): compute piecewise Wathan e1RM, bodyweight/sex/age-adjusted strength score, tier (untrained -> elite), and kg needed for the next tier from one set.

tools.name: interference_tax
tools.description: Public calculator (NO token needed): audit a weekly hybrid training schedule for AMPK-mTOR concurrent training interference (<3h high / 3-6h moderate window), 36h long-run glycogen depletion before legs, 48h heavy hinge recovery before speed runs, back-to-back quality runs, and Seiler 80/20 polariza

tools.name: volume_audit
tools.description: Public calculator (NO token needed): audit a weekly lifting split across all 17 muscle groups using fractional set accounting (1.0x primary mover, 0.5x secondary synergist, RPE >= 6 hard-set filter) against Schoenfeld & Pelland MEV / MAV / MRV landmarks.

tools.name: hyrox_splits
tools.description: Public calculator (NO token needed): compute all 8 compromised Hyrox 1 km lap splits (with preceding station fatigue multipliers, Pro/Doubles offsets, and Lap 1 overpacing blow-up cost) from a standalone 5K time using STRUGGL's 200,000-finisher decay model.

tools.name: plates_zone2
tools.description: Public calculator (NO token needed): convert a reference set (weight x reps @ RPE) into piecewise Wathan e1RM, Zourdos RIR/RPE working weight (accounting for bodyweight on pull_up/chin_up/dip), exact gym barbell plate pairs per side, and Tanaka + Karvonen Heart Rate Reserve Zone 2 bpm (eliminating t

tools.name: hyrox_autopsy
tools.description: Public calculator (NO token needed): post-race or simulation Hyrox diagnostic — compares actual 8x1 km run splits and 8 functional station times against empirical compromised pacing targets and P25-P75 station variance benchmarks to pinpoint exact time leaks.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
